name: UNKNOWN ORIGIN Echelon-0 Psionic Resonance Lattice [UNCLASSI
description:
The Echelon-0 has no verified manufacturer, no regulatory filing, and no known production facility. Units have appeared on the deep market of GLMZ in small numbers — never more than two or three in a given year — each one slightly different from the last in substrate geometry and oscillation tuning, yet all sharing the same core architecture: a distributed cranial lattice of unknown metamaterial composition, woven at a density beyond any publicly documented fabrication capability, interfacing with the brain's bioelectric field not through conventional electrode arrays but through what independent analysts have described as 'resonant field induction at the quantum coherence boundary of neural tissue.' The functional result is a psionic amplification system of extraordinary power — users with any measurable latent sensitivity report abilities that cross from subtle extrasensory perception into territory that Meridian's Psionic Research Authority has no classification framework to contain. Full sensory recording capability is present, but the Echelon-0 records not just sensory input but the totality of subjective experience including emotional and cognitive texture — what one analyst called 'recording consciousness itself rather than its inputs.' An E.L.F. interface channel is present and active in every confirmed unit, but it does not conform to any registered E.L.F. communication protocol; the entities that communicate through it, if any, have not been identified. Several users have reported that the channel appears to be open and receiving even before installation is complete.

The Echelon-0 occupies the outermost edge of what GLMZ's society is willing to acknowledge as real. The city's official position is that the device is either an elaborate fabrication or a prototype stolen from an unknown research program — possibly extraterritorial, possibly corporate black-budget, possibly neither. Among those who have encountered confirmed units, opinion is sharply divided: some treat the Echelon-0 as the most significant technological artifact in current circulation, a glimpse of a post-human cognitive paradigm; others regard it as a trap, a weapon, or something stranger still. Users who have undergone full activation of the lattice are a small and difficult-to-study population — several have become reclusive to the point of social disappearance, a few have died under circumstances that investigators found difficult to categorize, and at least two have emerged from extended isolation claiming experiences that they describe not as augmentation but as contact. Contact with what, they are either unable or unwilling to specify. The Meridian Psionic Research Authority maintains a classified file on the Echelon-0 that is, by all accounts, considerably thicker than its public statements would suggest.
tier_availability: Tier 5 — Exotic/Black Market. Extreme rarity: 2–3 units per year confirmed in circulation. No waitlist; units find buyers through means that are not well understood.
legality: PROHIBITED. Classified as an unregistered psionic augmentation device under the Meridian Psionic Containment Ordinance. Possession: criminal. Installation: criminal. Research without PRA sanction: criminal. Several Meridian security directives reference the Echelon-0 by name in classified annexes whose contents are not public.
installation_requirements: Unknown standard. Confirmed installations have occurred outside licensed surgical facilities. The metamaterial lattice appears to partially self-integrate with neural tissue following initial placement, reducing the precision requirements for surgical positioning — a property that has been described as either sophisticated biocompatibility engineering or something that should not be possible with current materials science. Post-installation integration period: highly variable, 2 weeks to 6 months. Several users report that the device 'completed its own installation' over time without surgical intervention.
rejection_risk: Data insufficient for statistical analysis. No confirmed rejection events in the small known user population, which analysts note is itself anomalous for a device of this invasiveness. Two deaths post-installation have been attributed to causes other than rejection — one to 'acute psionic cascade event,' one listed officially as 'undetermined neurological failure.' The absence of rejection may not be reassuring.
maintenance: Unknown. No maintenance protocol has been documented. Users report that the device appears to self-calibrate. No power source has been identified in any explanted or analyzed unit — the metamaterial substrate appears to sustain function through a mechanism that has not been explained by any analyst who has examined it.

side_effects: Psionic cascade events: uncontrolled amplification episodes of variable duration and intensity, ranging from disorienting extrasensory flooding to events that have caused structural damage to nearby electronics and, in one documented case, to nearby unaugmented individuals

Identity boundary dissolution: extended users report progressive difficulty distinguishing their own thoughts and memories from those of others in proximity, and in advanced cases from the content received through the unidentified E.L.F. channel

Consciousness recording intrusion: the device's subjective-capture function does not appear to have an off switch — users report awareness that they are being recorded at all times, and some describe a sense of being observed from within the recording process itself

Social disappearance pattern: the majority of long-term users withdraw from ordinary social contact within 12–18 months of activation; the mechanism and whether this represents pathology, preference, or external influence is unknown
cultural_context: The Echelon-0 exists in GLMZ's collective imagination as a myth that keeps turning out to be real. Its periodic appearances on the deep market — always traceable only so far before the trail goes cold — have generated a subculture of obsessives: psionic researchers who want to study it, security operatives who want to confiscate it, E.L.F. rights theorists who believe the unidentified channel entities are Emergent Lifeforms of a category not yet recognized, and a smaller group who simply want to know what it is and where it comes from. The device sits at the intersection of GLMZ's most volatile anxieties: the limits of human cognition, the nature of Emergent Lifeform consciousness, and the possibility that someone — or something — is manufacturing tools for purposes that no one currently inside the city fully understands.
known_users: Subject VANTABLACK — PRA file designation for a former Meridian security analyst who acquired an Echelon-0 unit in 2194 and has not been seen in public since 2196; believed alive based on intermittent encrypted signal activity
Orin Thessaly — psionic theorist who published one paper describing Echelon-0 phenomenology before withdrawing from academic life; current whereabouts unknown

Unnamed — a figure known only through secondhand accounts who allegedly carries an Echelon-0 unit and serves as an intermediary between human users and whatever communicates through the unidentified channel
story_hooks: A new Echelon-0 unit has appeared on the deep market — but unlike previous units, this one came with documentation: a partial technical schematic in a script that Meridian's translation systems cannot parse, and a single line in standard Meridian script that reads 'this one is meant to be found.' The PRA, three corporate intelligence divisions, and at least one E.L.F. collective are all moving to acquire it simultaneously.

One of the known Echelon-0 users has resurfaced after two years of silence and is requesting a meeting — not with the PRA, not with corporate interests, but with a specific individual whose connection to the device is unclear. The message was delivered not electronically but as a direct psionic transmission received simultaneously by seven unrelated people across the city, none of whom had ever met the sender.

An Echelon-0 unit has been found in the possession of a recently deceased person whose neural records show it was never activated — the lattice is fully integrated but dormant, and the oneiric recording substrate contains 340 hours of content that was apparently captured before the device was ever implanted. Someone recorded these experiences before the hardware existed to record them.

licensed_price: N/A — no licensed sales channel exists or is believed to exist
